title: Replayable L2 migration inflates account roots, stealing earned-Bean snapshot share
description: L2ContractMigrationFacet.redeemDepositsAndInternalBalances is permissionless and verifies only a Merkle proof over (owner, deposits, internalBalances, ownerRoots) plus an EIP-712 signature over (owner, reciever, deadline). It stores NO spent/redeemed marker and uses NO nonce. setStalk then does `s.accts[reciever].roots += ownerRoots;` (L2ContractMigrationFacet.sol#207) and `s.accts[reciever].stalk += accountStalk;` (#206) with accumulating adds. Because the proof and signature are public on-chain calldata and there is no replay guard, anyone can re-submit the same redeem call repeatedly before `deadline`, each time adding `ownerRoots` to the reciever's roots and `accountStalk` to its stalk. `roots` is the account's snapshot SHARE in the earned-Bean distribution (LibSilo._balanceOfEarnedBeans, LibSilo.sol#689: stalk*accountRoots/totalRoots). Inflated account roots directly inflate the holder's claim on every future season's minted Beans, drawn from the shared earnedBeans pool that belongs to honest stalkholders. This is the snapshot-consumer view of the replay defect; the replay/access-control root cause is owned by the access_control/logic specialists (DT-003).
impact: An attacker (or any griefer) replays a victim's public migration proof N times, multiplying the reciever's roots and stalk by N. The inflated roots steal a proportionally larger share of every subsequent season's earned-Bean mint from honest stalkholders, and the inflated stalk distorts all Stalk-weighted accounting. With ownerRoots attacker-influenced only via the signed leaf, the cap is the deadline window and gas. Unbacked snapshot weight => earned-Bean theft.

ite.intent: Inflate a reciever's roots (earned-Bean snapshot share) and stalk without backing, stealing future earned Beans from honest stalkholders.
ite.technique: Replay the public (proof, signature, ownerRoots) of a redeem call; setStalk's `+=` on roots/stalk accumulates each replay (L2ContractMigrationFacet.sol#206-207); no spent marker exists.
ite.evasion: MerkleProof.verify + ECDSA.recover are deterministic on identical inputs and were the only guards; the intended one-shot redemption is not enforced by any stored state.

ice_chain.consumer_action: computes the reciever's claimable share of season-minted Beans from its roots; inflated roots steal the shared earnedBeans pool
